description: Defines the ElementsUploadDataStream class, a non-chunked upload data stream composed of multiple upload elements, including methods for initialization, reading, and resetting the stream.

classes.name: ElementsUploadDataStream
classes.description: A class representing a non-chunked upload data stream composed of multiple upload elements, supporting initialization, reading, and reset operations.

methods.name: CreateWithReader
methods.description: Creates an ElementsUploadDataStream with a single UploadElementReader.

methods.name: IsInMemory
methods.description: Checks if the data stream is stored in memory.

methods.name: GetElementReaders
methods.description: Returns the list of upload element readers.

methods.name: InitInternal
methods.description: Initializes the data stream internally with logging support.

methods.name: ReadInternal
methods.description: Reads data from the stream into a buffer.

methods.name: ResetInternal
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the data stream.

methods.name: InitElements
methods.description: Initializes all upload element readers starting from a given index.

methods.name: OnInitElementCompleted
methods.description: Callback when an element finishes initialization.

methods.name: ReadElements
methods.description: Reads data from the current upload element readers.

methods.name: OnReadElementCompleted
methods.description: Callback when a read operation on an element completes.

methods.name: ProcessReadResult
methods.description: Processes the result of reading from an upload element.
